description_en: Queries the total number and proportions of HTTP status codes returned during back-to-origin routing
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRealTimeSrcHttpCodeData查询加速域名回源HTTP返回码的总数和占比数据
name: DescribeDomainRealTimeSrcHttpCodeData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify up to 100 domain names in each call. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持100个域名查询
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

> 结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time
